findings.summary: SIRE Readiness Score page shows 0 GREEN chapters despite chapters with no findings and scores ≥70
findings.evidence: The summary counters display: 10 CHAPTERS, 0 GREEN, 8 ISSUES. Of the 10 chapter rows visible, Chapter 2 (Crew Management, score 70, 0 findings), Chapter 7 (Safety Management, score 68, 0 findings), Chapter 9 (Electrical Systems, score 66, 0 findings), and Chapter 10 (Mooring Operations, score 72, 0 findings) all have 0 findings. Chapters 2 and 10 score at or above 70. The GREEN counter nonetheless renders as 0.
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the summary row: 10 CHAPTERS | 0 GREEN | 8 ISSUES
Compare with the Chapter Scores list — multiple chapters have 0 findings and scores ≥70
findings.expected: GREEN count should reflect chapters that meet the green threshold (score ≥70 or 0 findings); at minimum chapters 2 and 10 should be counted, giving GREEN ≥ 2
findings.actual: GREEN counter displays 0 regardless of chapter data

findings.summary: Dashboard greeting renders 'Good morning, Captain Captain' — rank is duplicated
findings.evidence: The page text includes 'Good morning, Captain Captain' on every load. The sidebar shows the user as 'Captain Ahmad Fauzi / fleet manager', indicating the rank 'Captain' is stored separately from the name; the greeting concatenates both, producing the duplicate.
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the greeting heading near the top of the page content
findings.expected: Greeting should read 'Good morning, Captain Ahmad Fauzi' or 'Good morning, Captain'
